entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... I need to ask about a return, please.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
Yes, it's Mark Peterson. Order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Mark. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see your order for the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered about six weeks ago. What specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They just... they're awful for my feet. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but they keep giving me terrible blisters. I just can't wear them.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.
I hope so. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was just so disappointed. I was really counting on getting a refund; things are a bit tight this month.

I understand completely, Mark. And thank you for your loyalty. Okay, I've checked our policy. Your cycling shoes fall under our standard 90-day return window. Since you're at day 42, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can send them back?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the refund back to your original payment method.
Wow. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome, Mark. I'm glad we could resolve this for you. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and happy holidays.
